en.title: Invitation to an online symposium for Asteroid Day 2021
en.excerpt: The Regional Office of Astronomy for Development in the Arab World, AUASS and the Jordanian Astronomical Society invite you to an online symposium for Asteroid Day 2021, Sunday 27 June 2021 at 6 pm, via Zoom.
en.body:
The Regional Office of Astronomy for Development in the Arab World,
the Arab Union for Astronomy and Space Sciences
and the Jordanian Astronomical Society

are pleased to invite you to an online symposium
for International Asteroid Day 2021
Asteroid Day 2021

Time: 6:00 pm, Sunday, 27 June 2021

via Zoom
